items.title: Rethinking the user interface of AI, open source<3
items.raw_excerpt: Hi everyone, I've spent the last year using tools like NotebookLM and ChatGPT for stuff ranging from studying, research, and writing. Its been okay, but I've found that this standard chat interface has been a bottleneck for sustained work. The answers are useful, but all of the information remain limited in linear, ephemeral threads than would also span across multiple conversations. ThinkEx is an open-source alternative that augments the normal the chat interface with a spatial, grid-like canvas. It works like a physical desk: instead of your context scrolling away or getting lost across different windows, you spread out PDFs, videos, and notes side-by-side to interact them easily. Its fully open source as well :)

items.title: 阿里Qoder上线Quest 1.0智能体，可自我学习与进化
items.raw_excerpt: 1月14日消息，阿里Qoder上线能自我学习与快速进化的自主智能体Quest 1.0，该智能体无需用户干预，即可自主理解需求、规划方案、修复BUG并最终验证交付，真正让不懂代码的用户也能完成应用开发，推动AI 编程进入自主进化时代。   阿里Qoder上线能自我学习与快速进化的自主智能体Quest 1.0 现有主流AI 编程工具需要开发者持续关注AI的执行过程，并需要人力审查AI生成的内容、手动纠正错误。Qoder上线的Quest 1.0在集成全球顶尖Coding模型的基础之上，创新性应用了自进化智能体（Self-Evolving Agent ），能深度分析项目代码结构、架构演进以及团队规范等，并实现自我学习与进化。  面对复杂工程时，全新的Qoder Quest不会直接写代码，而是先生成技术规约（Spec），明确需求边界、技术选型、验收标准，同时通过内置的多个子智能体并行探索不同实现路径，择优而行，有效提升代码生成效果。遇到代码报错时，Qoder Quest还能自动诊断根因、生成修复方案、验证修复效果，直到问题解决，整个过程无需人类持续介入。 据介绍，Qoder Quest还新增支持 Skills功能，让智能体学会更多的技能，比如编写规约（Spec）、制作网站、设计原型、处理文档等标准化技能包，极大地拓展了AI编程的能力边界。 Qoder 负责人丁宇表示：“AI 编程经历了从代码补全到结对编程的演进，但本质上还是工具思维，即「AI做一步，人确认一步」，Quest 1.0代表全新的范式。我们希望不仅仅是创造一个更好的工具，还是一个会学习、会反思、会进化的AI工程师。”

excerpt_i18n.en:
On January 14, Alibaba Qoder launched Quest 1.0, a self-learning and rapidly evolving autonomous agent. This agent can independently understand requirements, plan solutions, fix bugs, and ultimately verify and deliver results without user intervention, enabling even users without coding knowledge to complete application development and advancing AI programming into an era of autonomous evolution.

Existing mainstream AI programming tools require developers to continuously monitor the AI's execution process, manually review AI-generated content, and correct errors. Building on the integration of top global coding models, Qoder's Quest 1.0 innovatively applies a Self-Evolving Agent, capable of deeply analyzing project code structure, architectural evolution, and team standards to achieve self-learning and evolution.

When tackling complex engineering tasks, the new Qoder Quest does not directly write code. Instead, it first generates technical specifications (Spec) to clarify requirement boundaries, technology selections, and acceptance criteria. Simultaneously, it leverages multiple built-in sub-agents to explore different implementation paths in parallel, selecting the optimal one to effectively enhance code generation outcomes. When encountering code errors, Qoder Quest can automatically diagnose root causes, generate fixes, and verify the effectiveness of repairs until the issue is resolved.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 14 de enero, Alibaba Qoder lanzó el agente autónomo inteligente Quest 1.0, capaz de autoaprendizaje y evolución rápida. Meta's multi-billion dollar acquisition of Manus reflects its confidence in the evolution of "intelligent capability" from "brain-only" to "brain-and-hand" proficiency. IT veteran Li Guoping commented on Manus's change of ownership, noting that the "intelligent capability" refers to the composite ability of agents in cognition and execution. In his view, the SaaS industry is also undergoing its own intelligent transformation—"If SaaS continues to rely mainly on human-system (interface) interaction without embracing intelligent transformation, it will inevitably be overturned by the times." The fundamental shift in human-computer interaction models represents a disruptive change brought by the Agent wave to the SaaS industry.

This perspective stems from Li Guoping's decades of firsthand experience with transformative moments: in the software era, operating systems were the core of the digital world; in the PC internet era, portals and later search engines became the gateways to the digital world; in the mobile internet era, apps took over as the entry point; and in the cloud computing era, SaaS integrated and encapsulated all capabilities. Li Guoping, who worked at Microsoft for over a decade, currently serves as the Dean of the Digital Economy and Fintech Research Institute at Baiwang Co., Ltd., a leading domestic tax and finance SaaS provider. Over the nearly 20 years since the rise of cloud computing, he has consistently embraced and adopted new technological waves.

Where will the future of SaaS head under the Agent wave? In Li Guoping's view, SaaS is unlikely to disappear within the next five years but will first transition toward embedded, localized intelligent applications.

Powered by the core engine Shadow AI 2.0, these products form a closed-loop workflow of "recording, documentation, execution, and collaboration," driving TicNote to evolve into a knowledge management and collaboration ecosystem. From expanding hardware forms and iterating on self-developed agents to developing a supporting collaboration platform, these changes mark Mobvoi's commitment to empowering the next stage of organizational collaboration through the TicNote ecosystem.

The launch of the TicNote series redefines the smart experience. As the first AI recording earbuds supporting 4G networks, TicNote Pods do not rely on smartphones, enabling faster upload of recordings to the cloud for AI processing and returning results to users, with a 50% speed increase compared to traditional connection methods. The earbuds are no longer just accessories or extensions of phones but independent AI terminals.
